messages:
adeel (pr): APAC tech blog just DM'd asking if they can publish a short teaser of our benchmark tomorrow morning JST. They say embargos are different regionally.

ruth (content): Our global embargo is 08:00 PT. We don't want region-specific exceptions.

zhen (product): Why JST specifically? Are they asking for numbers or just a quote?

adeel (pr): They want a 1-line exec comment + a methods sentence. No raw tables. They said their audience is morning-first; asking if we can let them publish ~00:30 JST which is still embargoed globally but different wall clock.

lisa (legal): We treat embargo as absolute across outlets. We can't allow staggered releases that surface results earlier in other timezones.

kai (social-ops): If they run earlier in JST, our owned channels (global) could look out of sync. Not ideal.

adeel (pr): Proposed reply: "Thanks — we have a global embargo at 08:00 PT. We're happy to share an embargoed quote and methods blurb you can hold to that time. We cannot approve earlier publishing in any timezone." Thoughts?

ruth (content): Agree. Send an embargoed blurb they can carry. Keep quote neutral and non-comparative.

zhen (product): Draft method note (short): "End-to-end latency measured across regions with consistent routing; cost estimated from tokenized workloads and batch-aware execution to reflect real deployments"

lisa (legal): Tweak: change "real deployments" -> "settings commonly used by our customers". Approving the rest.

ruth (content): Draft quote: "These benchmarks capture recent improvements to inference latency and per-token cost across deployment patterns we commonly see." Short and neutral.

kai (social-ops): Heads-up: we'll queue APAC local posts to go live at embargo lift in local timezones once blog URL is up.

adeel (pr): Sending email now with embargo language and both snippets. Will ask them to confirm they will not publish early in JST or elsewhere.

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Email to APAC reporter sent (ID: 2026-03-26-APAC-07).

adeel (pr): Reporter replied: "Understood, we'll hold and confirm once copy is queued"

kai (social-ops): Good. Also note: if any regional outlet tries to run early, tag this thread and we'll loop in exec-comms.

ruth (content): Saving the final approved quote + methods here for reference.

adeel (pr): Quote: \"These benchmarks capture recent improvements to inference latency and per-token cost across deployment patterns we commonly see.\"

Methods: \"End-to-end latency was measured across regions with consistent routing; cost estimates are derived from tokenized workloads using batch-aware execution patterns to reflect settings commonly used by our customers. Results are intended to show comparative trends rather than absolute performance for any single customer workload.\"

adeel (pr): Closing thread unless we hear otherwise.
